name: PrimaryHalfBridge

ports.name: HI_IN
ports.meaning: High-side gate drive input from dead-time logic (PWM with non-overlap)

ports.name: LO_IN
ports.meaning: Low-side gate drive input from dead-time logic (PWM with non-overlap, complementary to HI_IN)

ports.name: SW_OUT
ports.meaning: Switching node output to LLC resonant tank (0V to 48V square wave at 100-500kHz)

ports.name: VCC_12V
ports.meaning: +12V supply for gate driver power (IR2110 VCC pin)

ports.name: VDD_5V
ports.meaning: +5V logic supply for gate driver input circuits (IR2110 VDD pin)

notes: V_BUS_48V and GND are power symbols, not ports - they connect by name across the design
HI_IN and LO_IN must have dead-time (non-overlap) to prevent shoot-through
Typical dead-time requirement: 100-200ns for IPP80N05S4-02 MOSFETs
Bootstrap circuit requires VS to drop to near GND periodically to recharge Cboot
Minimum duty cycle for bootstrap recharge: ~10% low-side on-time
SW_OUT connects directly to LLC resonant tank (Lr + Cr series network)
